author: Rohan Deshmukh
title: Trick to remember 2D Array row-major vs column-major
content: In C, 2D arrays are stored in Row-Major order! Formula for element (i, j): Address = Base + (i * TotalColumns + j) * sizeof(element). Remember: in C, the rightmost index changes fastest!

author: Ananya Sharma
title: Quick mnemonic for Postfix evaluation
content: Whenever you encounter an operand (number), push to stack. Whenever you encounter an operator (+, -, *, /), pop two operands, apply operator: second_popped <op> first_popped, and push the result back!

author: Kavya Nair
title: Circular Queue condition without confusion
content: Why is (rear + 1) % SIZE == front full? Because we leave one slot empty or check if incrementing rear hits front. Drawing a clock face makes circular queue 10x easier to explain in vivas!

author: Tanisha Rai
title: Difference between private vs protected inheritance
content: In public inheritance, public stays public, protected stays protected. In protected inheritance, both become protected. In private inheritance, everything inherited becomes private in the derived class!
